sentinels.purpose: Every repository-name-shaped value, token prefix and PEM header in the tests is assembled at runtime; no committed file carries a credential-shaped literal.
ZERO governed reads, ZERO PACMI calls, ZERO authenticated provider operations, ZERO real provider values, ZERO DB connections; the provider is the fake world.

positive_controls.description: Same project, same run, exact value, entropy only: the V-R2.L7 record is validated evidence carrying exactly ONE adjudication in its single permitted form, bound to the same team + project, carrying no provider value.

Exact valid positive control inside a cross-project scenario: A's own deployments are adjudicated in the same run while B's page carrying A's value STOPs; a longer witnessed name is adjudicated exactly.
EC-1: in-run (executor same-run binding AND the bundle's own V-R2.S2 binding) and standalone (bundle binding) re-scans explain the adjudicated L7 findings and nothing else.
The real dn0ConfigFor binds seven events with 00d6d383's delta recert fixed; the six materialized events satisfy CP-1 as configured.

negative_controls.description: Case-changed, different same-shape name, trailing space, owner-prefixed, .git suffix, URL form, prefix (substring), superstring, NFKC-equivalent fullwidth form, and one differing deployment in a page: each STOPs.
Cross-project substitution (B never adjudicated; A and B adjudicated with different repos) and the same projectId under another team/scope: STOP.
Historical witness only (a previous executor adjudicated the project): the new run STOPs; the binding has no setter.
No prior V-R2.S2 adjudication, S2 unresolved (pending; traversal complete but no verdict), zero G-R5 match, duplicate G-R5 match, witness name mismatch: STOP.

Grammar-invalid value; PRIVATE_KEY + entropy; GITHUB_TOKEN_FAMILY, URL_USERINFO, ENV_ASSIGNMENT_SECRET + entropy; the witnessed value at deployments[*].name: STOP with the named detector in the certified diagnostic.
Each layer of the L7 predicate (path, located detector, grammar, value detectors, exact equality, non-empty set) is independently load-bearing.

Not global: an L7 adjudication on another op, a second entry, another scope, exact_equality false, a historical witness op, a corroboration claim or an extra key are refused by the envelope; V-R4.DEPLOYMENTS stays refused in this phase.

EC-1: caller lookup alone, bundle alone (in-run), an adjudication borrowed by a record requested for another project, a forged scope, a missing marker, a grammar-invalid value, a mixed value (0 explained) and an ambiguous bundle source are all unexplained.
The 00d6d383 delta recert cannot certify a new candidate.

mutation_controls.description: Same-project binding removed; bound to another project's adjudication; team/scope dropped (L01, L08, L09) must be KILLED.
Historical witness allowed; G-R5 provenance bypassed; unresolved S2 accepted (L02, L10, L11) must be KILLED.

Case folding; equality removed (any grammar-valid value); grammar removed; entropy + another detector accepted; value detector check removed; path restriction removed; exception globalized (L03-L07, L12, L13) must be KILLED.
Envelope and EC-1 scope binding removed; bundle binding or caller lookup dropped; EC-1 detector or grammar layer removed (L14-L19) must be KILLED.
The fixed 00d6d383 event dropped, or accepted for the new candidate (L20, L21) must be KILLED.
Every earlier production mutant (M/N/D/W/P, 100) re-killed on this tree; the battery still FAILS on a real survivor (self-test).
